output.reason: [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and [ev-1295567312b0] say the `istiod-remote` Helm chart was merged into `istio-discovery`, so the clusters affected are the ones installed with `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote`. The proposed condition `global.profile` unset is far too broad: it flags every istiod install that doesn't set a profile, including ordinary local control planes that the change doesn't touch. None of the predicates in the vocabulary can say which chart a Helm release came from, so the exposure has to be marked undecidable, with a note on what information would settle it.

correction.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart is merged into the istio-discovery (istio/istiod) chart; only clusters installed with the istio/istiod-remote chart for a remote/external control plane are exposed and must install istio/istiod with --set profile=remote.

exposure.needed: whether the cluster's Istio installation was deployed from the istio/istiod-remote Helm chart (remote/external control plane)
